niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel clear, compact, and task-focused, with strong hierarchy, minimal chrome, and concise copy. They like screens that show enough information to feel complete and functional, but not so much that they become crowded or promotional. They respond well to obvious primary actions, explicit progress or status cues, and app-like layouts that are structured and easy to scan. They also prefer brighter, lighter, more polished compositions over dark or heavy ones, except in some alert contexts where a darker, more integrated treatment can feel appropriate.

criteria.description: Prefers screens with minimal header chrome, fewer competing modules, and a streamlined single-column or otherwise simple layout.
Prefers short, direct, task-focused copy over explanatory, marketing-like, or verbose text.
Prefers clear title-first structure, obvious section separation, and a single dominant focal area or action.
Prefers the main CTA to be highly visible, unambiguous, and visually distinct from secondary actions.
Prefers clear step counts, setup progress, or concrete status messaging that makes the user’s current state obvious.
Prefers screens that feel populated and complete, with enough visible settings or content to avoid emptiness, but without dense clutter.
Prefers interfaces that feel integrated and functional, with clear grouping, rows, cards, or sections that make the page feel organized and app-like.
Prefers lighter, brighter, more polished visuals with good contrast and legibility, and generally dislikes heavy, dark, or promotional styling.
